tw: Go, Kron, go! Grab the bagels in the bag before they go bad!
twc: 冲啊 Kron，冲！趁袋里的百吉饼还没变质快抢回来！

tw: Kron's electric car gets a tricky lecture from a cricket on the carpet.
twc: Kron 的电动汽车在地毯上被一只蟋蟀狠狠训了一顿。
hint: 电车没油可加，只能挨训。

tw: Kron's electrical appliance applies apple pie to the elegant elephant's lips. Click!
twc: Kron 的电器咔嗒一声，把苹果派塞到了优雅大象的嘴边。
hint: 电器最会伺候大象吃饭。

tw: Kron and his climbing mate watch climate change change their snowman into a strange puddle.
twc: Kron 和登山伙伴眼看气候变化把雪人变成一滩怪水。

tw: A noisy oink choir begs Kron to join in, so Kron joins in: oink, oink!
twc: 吵闹的哼哼合唱团请 Kron 加入，Kron 就跟着哼哼！

tw: Kron's engineering puts a ring on a reindeer's ear near the engine.
twc: Kron 搞工程，在发动机旁给驯鹿的耳朵装了个圈。
hint: 工程师的杰作：驯鹿耳环。

tw: A well-respected woodpecker inspects Kron's vest and pecks a hole in the best spot.
twc: 德高望重的啄木鸟检查 Kron 的背心，在最佳位置啄个洞。

tw: Smokejumper Kron jumps, jumps, jumps, and stomps out one smoky pumpkin.
twc: 空降消防员 Kron 跳啊跳啊跳，一脚踩灭一个冒烟的南瓜。
hint: 从天而降，只为一个南瓜。

tw: Kron is the best in the field of feeding eels in a real field of peas.
twc: Kron 是喂鳗鱼领域的高手，就在一片真的豌豆地里喂。

tw: Kron takes the college entrance examination while a collie eats his exam at the entrance.
twc: Kron 参加高考，一只牧羊犬在门口把他的试卷吃了。

tw: Kron hides a sugar pill in the sugar bowl, but Bill the pug spills it.
twc: Kron 把糖丸藏在糖碗里，结果哈巴狗比尔把糖全洒在他身上。
hint: 想骗狗吃药，自己先吃糖。

tw: Chief engineer Kron cheers as a cheetah steers his engine near the cheese pier.
twc: 总工程师 Kron 在奶酪码头边欢呼，一只猎豹在开他的船。
hint: 总工程师管机器，不管谁开。

tw: "Go outside," said Mum, so Kron goes outside with the whole inside: sofa, bed and slide.
twc: 妈妈说出去玩，Kron 就把屋里的沙发、床和滑梯全搬到外面。

tw: Kron eats more and more s'mores, and the bear next door roars for more.
twc: Kron 吃了越来越多的棉花糖夹心饼，隔壁的熊吼着还要。

tw: Kron and a bodybuilder lamb chat in body language, flexing and wiggling on the landing.
twc: Kron 和健美小羊在楼梯口用肢体语言聊天，秀肌肉又扭屁股。

tw: Kron hisses at a prehistoric history book, and a dino hops out of the story.
twc: Kron 冲着史前历史书嘶嘶叫，一只恐龙从故事里跳了出来。

tw: Kron is a type of tiger who types on a tiny typewriter all night.
twc: Kron 是一种会整夜在小打字机上打字的老虎。
hint: 这种老虎不吃人，只打字。

tw: Kron gives general education to a gentle general, who educates a cat at the station.
twc: Kron 给一位温和的将军上通识课，将军却在车站教猫。

tw: Kron and a long, long snake go back a long way, back to baby days.
twc: Kron 和一条长长的蛇是老交情了，从小宝宝时就认识。

tw: Kron tries to be similar to six simple seals, so he wears a simple seal suit.
twc: Kron 想和六只海豹一样，就穿上了一件简单的海豹服。
